--- text
alpha [beta] gamma
--- keys
Cmd+X
--- expect
alpha | gamma
--- note
Cut deletes exactly the selection and nothing else, then collapses the caret
to the gap the text left behind. "beta" and its two bracketing spaces are the
whole story: after the cut the caret sits between the leading space and the
trailing space, at the offset the selection started from. No trailing
fragment of the cut word is left, and neither surrounding space is consumed.
